component.name: Longcar
component.summary: Virtual displays for Sunshine and Moonlight

description.p: Longcar extends your GNOME desktop onto a tablet or phone by creating virtual displays with Mutter's ScreenCast API, running one isolated stock Sunshine instance per screen, and streaming each one to a Moonlight or Artemis client.
Manage screens, presets, pairing, codec and bitrate caps, network discovery and recovery from the app, the command line, or a Quick Settings toggle in the GNOME top panel.

screenshot.caption: Screens with per-device audio, touch, bitrate and position controls
Audio page: host output, per-sink volume and per-screen routing
Behavior settings, with Diagnostics built in

description.p: Network page link and throughput test: the host Wi-Fi link (SSID, signal, negotiated rates, channel) plus an on-demand LAN speed test you run from the tablet's browser.
Audio page with host sinks, per-screen capture sink and host-sink restoration; per-screen keyboard, mouse and controller switches; CLI quick controls plus configuration export and import.
Per-device audio and native-touch switches, bitrate and layout quick controls in the app and the Quick Settings menu, doctor moved into Settings, and a new monitor icon.
First release: virtual display management, per-screen Sunshine instances, presets, pairing, Quick Settings control.
